title: SafeCommit: Certifying When Memory-Grounded Agents May Safely Act
title_zh: SafeCommit：认证基于记忆的智能体何时可安全行动
abstract_en: Long-horizon agents increasingly use persistent memory and tools to take actions with external side effects. A central failure mode is premature commitment: an agent acts before resolving whether its memory grounding is stale, conflicting, incomplete, or corrupted. We formalize this problem as safe commitment under memory uncertainty and introduce SafeCommit, a risk controlled layer between agent reasoning and external execution. The layer constructs a calibrated set of plausible latent worlds from memory, observations, tool outputs, provenance, and policy constraints. It permits a side effectful action only when a conformal action certificate shows that the action is safe in every retained world. Otherwise, it selects a low-side-effect probe that targets the worlds blocking certification, or returns a conservative fallback. Under calibrated world coverage, the probability of an unsafe certified commit is at most the target level α; with imperfect world proposal, the bound separates calibration and representation error. A dependency-free controlled simulator illustrates the safety-utility tradeoff and reproduces all reported results with one command. The goal is to offer a concrete approach for deciding not only what an agent should do, but when the available evidence is sufficient to safely do it.
abstract_zh: 随着长程智能体越来越多地使用持久记忆和工具执行具有外部副作用的动作，一个核心风险是“过早承诺”（premature commitment）：智能体在尚未确认其记忆依据是否过时、冲突、不完整或被污染前就采取行动。本文将该问题形式化为记忆不确定性下的安全承诺（safe commitment），并提出 SafeCommit：一个位于智能体推理与外部执行之间的风险控制层。SafeCommit 根据记忆、观测、工具输出、溯源信息和策略约束，构造一组经过校准的潜在世界集合；只有当 conformal action certificate 证明某个具有副作用的动作在所有保留世界中都安全时，系统才允许执行。否则，它会选择低副作用的探测动作，以针对阻碍认证的潜在世界补充证据，或返回保守回退方案。在校准世界覆盖成立时，已认证动作仍不安全的概率至多为目标水平 α；若世界提议不完美，理论界限可分解为校准误差与表示误差。论文还提供了一个无依赖的受控模拟器，用于展示安全性与效用之间的权衡，并支持一条命令复现实验结果。本文目标是为智能体提供一种具体机制，不仅决定“应该做什么”，也决定“证据何时足以安全地做”。
key_points_zh: 提出 SafeCommit，将记忆不确定性下的外部行动执行建模为 safe commitment 问题，重点防止智能体因过时、冲突或受污染记忆而过早采取高风险动作。
方法在智能体推理与工具执行之间加入风险控制层，基于记忆、观测、工具输出、provenance 和 policy constraints 构造可能的 latent worlds。
只有当 conformal action certificate 证明动作在所有保留的潜在世界中均安全时，SafeCommit 才允许具有外部副作用的 commit。
若无法认证安全性，系统会选择低副作用 probe 来收集能区分阻碍世界的证据，或采用 conservative fallback，避免盲目执行。
理论上，在 calibrated world coverage 条件下，不安全认证提交的概率上界为 α；实验通过无依赖模拟器展示安全—效用权衡并支持一键复现。

llm_assessment.comment: A strong safety layer for memory-grounded agents that gates side-effectful actions with calibrated certificates and probing policies.
llm_assessment.comment_zh: 这是一项较强的记忆驱动智能体安全层工作，用校准证书和探测策略来控制有外部副作用的行动。
